image_description: A brown pelican is captured in flight, skimming low over a body of water with ripples. The bird has dark brown/grey plumage on its body and wings, with a white head and neck. Its distinctive long bill with a gular pouch is clearly visible, pointing downwards towards the water. One wing is raised high, showing separated primary feathers, while the other is lower. The legs are tucked back.
